text: 1.Aged between 18 and 30 years old; 2.HSK level 3 or above 3.Senior high school graduation certificate or equivalent or above,with good marks 4.Additional explanation: Applicants, who do not meet the above requirements, may be considered on an individual basis. They may be admitted as non-degree seeking students for one academic year. Those who pass the examinations held one year later will be automatically accepted as regular students. Those who fail will return to their home country as graduate students after completing some courses in a program.
